post.summary: Ingest telemetry records (JSON or CSV upload)
post.description:
Ingest telemetry records into the embedded SQLite store.

Supported content types:
- application/json: body may be a single object or an array of objects.
  Each object: {asset_id: str, timestamp: ISO-8601 datetime, readings|sensor: {<k>: <v>, ...}}
- multipart/form-data: provide file field 'file' containing CSV with columns:
  asset_id,timestamp,<sensor...>

Returns the count of inserted rows and their database ids.

get.description:
Retrieve telemetry points for an asset within a time range.

Query parameters:
- assetId: asset identifier
- from/to: ISO-8601 timestamps
- agg: one of none|min|max|avg|p50|p90
- interval: bucket size in seconds (required when agg != none)

Response is a flattened list of points: (timestamp, key, value).

parameters.name: interval

schema.description: Bucket interval in seconds; required when agg is not 'none'.
schema.title: Interval

parameters.description: Bucket interval in seconds; required when agg is not 'none'.

post.description:
Compute a baseline failure risk score using a simple rule-based threshold strategy.

Request options:
A) Provide `readings` (and optionally `asset_id`, `timestamp`) to run inference directly.
B) Provide `asset_id` only to fetch the most recent telemetry from storage and infer.

Returns a PredictionResult: {risk_score (0-1), severity, recommendation}.

get.description:
Return metadata about the currently active prediction strategy.

For this POC the strategy is deterministic and rule-based; this endpoint mirrors
a typical ML model registry 'active model' descriptor.

get.summary: List alerts with filtering, sorting, and pagination
get.description:
List alerts from storage with optional filters:
- assetId: filter by asset
- severity: filter by severity (critical/high/medium/low)
- acknowledged: true/false
- from/to: created_at time window (ISO-8601)

Supports sorting and pagination and returns `total` count for the query.

schema.description: Filter by severity: critical, high, medium, low.

post.description:
Acknowledge one or more alerts by id. Captures acknowledgement timestamp and optional user/comment.

Body: {ids: [...], acked_by?: str, ack_comment?: str}

Create demo assets (if missing) and generate an initial batch of realistic telemetry for each asset.

This endpoint is intended for POC/demo environments and for bootstrapping the frontend with data.

Start a background task that periodically generates telemetry for existing assets and creates alerts when predictions indicate high risk.

Jittered interval is controlled by SIM_INTERVAL_SECONDS env var (default: 2-5 seconds).
Stop the background telemetry simulator task if it is running.
